rationale: Pulp's Control GPU-health integration must distinguish a hardware adapter from Dawn's CPU and Null validation adapters so product diagnostics cannot report software or API-validation execution as hardware-backed rendering. This change exposes Dawn/WebGPU's existing adapter-type and backend facts through the existing GpuSurface adapter-info snapshot; it does not change adapter selection, device creation, rendering, presentation, generic lifecycle instrumentation, or the render-skia-dawn ownership boundary. The fields are consumed only by Pulp-owned health classification and fail closed when unavailable, so this is Pulp-only product diagnostics integration with no named immutable Vellum framework commit to backport.
